title: The Analog Generation: A Podcast
description: A podcast I conceived and host, interviewing people nearing 90 years of age to understand how India used to be in the 1940s. Seen. Lived. Now told – history from the heart through the homes, memories, traditions and struggles of the people who lived it, recorded before these stories disappear.

title: The 2024 General Elections in India: A ‘YouTube Election’?
description: A chapter in De Gruyter’s Handbook of Digital Political Communication, edited by Mark Wheeler and Petros Iosifidis. In 2014 India had its ‘Facebook election’ and in 2019 its ‘WhatsApp election’; in 2024, the general election seemed to be fought on YouTube. With public trust in mainstream media at an all-time low, the chapter examines the role of YouTube in the 2024 elections and asks whether the platform helps level the playing field for alternative voices.

title: Health Communication in India: Strategies and Digital Innovations
description: India accounts for 20% of the global disease burden despite having only 17% of the world’s population. Edited by Shalini Narayanan and Sunetra Sen Narayan (Routledge), this volume explores how India tackles health communication across its linguistic, cultural and socio-economic diversity – from theoretical foundations and campaigns on cancer, tuberculosis, leprosy and COVID-19 to mHealth, artificial intelligence and the challenge of health misinformation.

title: The WhatsApp India Story: Inside the Digital Maya Sphere
description: WhatsApp is used by over half a billion people in India today – in business, government, education and among friends and families. Co-authored with Sunetra Sen Narayan (Routledge), this book critically explores the messaging app’s rapid expansion in India and asks whether, as a form of horizontal communication, it challenges more traditional structures of communication. Now available in the South Asia edition at ₹1000.

title: Ek dopahar station ki
description: A story in 3 parts on raagdelhi.com about two boys and their adventures in a railway station.

title: Ittisikahani
description: कहानियां जो दिल को छू लें। Collection of short stories that reveal life’s big truths.

title: #सूक्ष्मकथाएं
description: एक पैरा की छोटी सी कहानियां जो दिल और ज़मीन से जुड़ी हुई हैं। अब तक छह सौ से ज़्यादा लिखी जा चुकी हैं इस फेसबुक पेज पर।

title: Identity:  A short story accepted by the University of Baltimore’s literary journal called Welter.
description: Step into a poignant tale of identity and tradition through ‘Echoes of Heritage.’ This narrative delves into the life of a young girl in a rural hamlet, where echoes of her grandmother’s legacy reverberate through every interaction. As she grapples with being seen only as her grandmother’s reflection, the story unfolds against the backdrop of Deepavali, a festival of lights that illuminates her path to self-discovery. Witness her poignant journey of asserting individuality amidst familial expectations, portrayed through evocative prose and heartfelt emotions.

title: Kissa: A Story Podcast
description: A story I wrote for Kissa: A Story Podcast as a contributing writer, was run by the podcaster, Jawahara Saidullah who lives abroad.

title: Looking for Myself
description: Delve into ‘Looking for Myself,’ a captivating novella crafted from the author’s Facebook blogs. Starting with a brief introduction, the narrative unfolds post her early retirement from a coveted Central Civil Services Group ‘A’ job in India. Navigating mid-life challenges, the author, still in her 40s, embarks on a quest for identity and purpose. Through open-hearted experiments and a resilient sense of humor, she reflects on the profound realization of life’s true priorities. Join her on this introspective journey within the pages of this slim volume.
